title: Shared-plan slots versus separate-plan blue-green
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare slots and separate plans; identify true isolation and lifecycle-control differences.
routingComparisonAxes: Fixed native shared-slot swap versus externally routed separate-plan path. External routing is not exclusive to separate plans; independently routable shared-plan slots can also control admission/drain while sharing compute.

sourceContract.readme: S124 | App Service, separate plans: Compare externally routed blue-green deployments with shared-plan slots for capacity isolation and lifecycle control.
sourceContract.backlog: D-S124 | Add shared-plan slots versus separate-plan externally routed blue-green comparison.
sourceContract.acceptance: Real capacity isolation, cost, routing, drain control, and user outcomes are compared without claiming independent fault domains for shared slots.
sourceContract.portableCard: A-S124 | Compare slots and separate plans; identify true isolation and lifecycle-control differences.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: B-S124 | Conduct one plan-placement comparison; verify native capacity, cost assumptions, and handoff/drain evidence.

preconditions: Every plan, slot, compute, warm-up, drain, retention, retirement, session and endpoint field is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
One two-worker plan has 24 fictional compute units; two separate plans have 24 each, 48 total.
The separate-plan example assumes two distinct dedicated compute pools; no actual tier or target is selected.
Cost 2 versus 4 is fictional worker units, not prices or a complete estimate; routing and dependency costs are excluded.
Two existing blue journeys overlap two new green observations within a fixed fictional 500 ms original budget.
Both placements share DATA-DEPENDENCY-COMMON; wider independent fault domains remain unverified.
actions: Compare a fixed strategy and condition
Optionally add fixed extra slot/content within an existing plan
Observe meaningful warm-up and shared-versus-separated overlap capacity
Request exact 100 percent new admissions and inspect fixed actual-destination receipts
For separate plans, observe bounded old-work drain, rollback window and guarded retirement
Inspect measured positive, negative and unknown results and retained current-run history
Explicitly reset only in-memory rehearsal state and focus
assertions: Additional content or slots change placement count, never compute, workers or plan cost units.
Separate plans isolate their compute pools, not automatically dependency, regional or platform fault domains.
Plan placement controls compute sharing; the selected routing mechanism controls admission/drain decisions. Shared slots are not universally barred from external routing.
Shared 28-unit overlap exceeds 24 units; each separate pool independently fits its demand.
HTTP 200 without initialized meaningful readiness safely blocks exposure.
Native swap recycling can abandon existing work despite retaining old slot content.
External routing preserves pending old work until actual fixed drain and retention receipts pass.
Session loss, missing receipts, pinned blue clients, shared dependency failure and host restart remain failed or unverified outcomes.
Closed typed commands and causal replay state reject coercion, forged fields and invalid lifecycle order without changing trace.
History retains up to 24 actions until explicit reset; native form.reset shadowing cannot break reset.
Actual DOM, keyboard, invalid input, resource failure, reset and CSP enforcement are browser-observed.

limits: No actual App Service/resource/configuration, native slots, plans, compute, warm-up, drain, sessions, identity, endpoint, deployment or retirement operation.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, credentials, identity registration, packages, frameworks, download or spend.
No selected native OS/SKU/region/subscription/resource group and no unsupported native auto-swap offered.
No live prices, telemetry, native Azure proof, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 validation or five-nines guarantee.
The published browser helper remains unqualified for general unattended lifecycle recovery; only this bounded observed run is evidence.
History is retained in the current memory-only rehearsal until an explicit reset; no durable persistence is claimed.
C005-C008 and local-harness integration remain parent-owned; this card changes only learning/S124.
Only parent acceptance can credit A-S124 once; tests, repairs, evidence and refinements earn zero additional credit.
